Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (September 9, 2021) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Tender (RFT), Ariba Doc No. 2947784083, Contract No. 21-PFR-CAP-044 Description: To provide all labour, equipment, materials, and supervision for the renovations and upgrades of Earlscourt Park Building 6 on behalf of the Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division of the City of Toronto. Recommended Supplier: Joe Pace & Sons Contracting Inc. Contract Award Value: $1,113,000 net of all applicable taxes and charges $1,257,690 including HST and all applicable charges $1,132,589 net of HST recoveries The contract is expected to start following the date of award and end by April 30, 2022.
